about: QT Town first-ten-minutes gate (NEXT-SLICES-3). OFFLINE only (blockDb + SDK stub + Play offline). Fresh profiles (localStorage cleared). Simulated time: the Phaser loop sleeps and the test steps game.headlessStep with a fixed 1/60 s. targets = the QT acceptance numbers. knownIssues = the measured value on the base branch for a target the game misses today (assert: not worse than this baseline; print the gap). legacySmall / legacyTiny / legacyUnderCanvas = frozen allow-lists of controls under 44 px / text under 12 px / controls whose centre shows the canvas, seen on the base branch: they may only shrink, a new offender fails.

legacySmall._notes: Measured on claude/animal-crossing-game-7z3roh @ 67cc086: every one is 40 px tall (the 44 px rule wants 4 more). The quick-chat row buttons send chat, so the test never taps them. On desktop the last quick-chat button is clipped (see legacyUnderCanvas), so it is not measured here.

legacyTiny._notes: Measured on 67cc086: 10-11 px text in the In-town panel (streak, town rating, tidy line, birthday line, bestie label, Map / World map) and the phone action-button labels (Emotes, Tilt, the A/B/P/C emoji captions).

legacyUnderCanvas._notes: Measured on 67cc086 at 1280x720: the In-town panel is overflow:auto and ends at y=304, so Dailies, Journal, Settings and the last quick-chat button sit below its visible area; their centre shows the game canvas until the panel is scrolled.
